name: Facet
text: Ship EXCAVA with a dark theme by default and a one-click toggle to light mode. This matches Manus’ competitive edge and Graphify’s proven dark interface, ensuring consistency with what users already expect. The trade-off is that light-mode users must click once to switch, but the default dark theme reduces eye strain in low light—a common use case for data work—without cluttering the interface.

name: Pane
text: Pane: The real risk isn’t user preference—it’s that a one-click toggle implies *performance parity* where none exists. Dark themes often mask readability flaws; forcing a default hides the work needed to make light mode truly viable. Settle it by testing both themes with real content at scale—if light mode’s readability lags, the toggle is a false promise.
